messages:
tian: Starting a limited canary: v3-int4 (quant) vs v3-fp16 baseline. 1% traffic, 2h window starting now. Target slices: long-docs (>1024), short Q&A, rerank.
deploy-bot: Canary initiated: id=canary-2024-04-09-01 nodes=4 target=1% details: https://infra/ci/canary-2024-04-09-01
rachael: Can we surface seqlen-weighted metrics on the canary dashboard? long-doc concordance is our main risk. :eyes:
sam: Added slice weights to the canary config:
```
seeds: [long-doc, short-qna, rerank]
weights: { long-doc: 0.5, short-qna: 0.3, rerank: 0.2 }
min_sample: 250
window: 15m
```
tian: Proposal for auto-fallback/rollback: hard rollback if concordance_delta <= -1.5% OR user_fuzzy_neg_rate increases >= 2pp OR latency_p99 > 300ms for two consecutive 15m windows. Soft-fallback: route long docs >2048 tokens to nf4-int4 variant.
mike: Suggest surfacing concordance_delta <= -1.0% as an alert but only count for rollback if it persists 3 windows or sample>=500. Keep p99 latency 300ms.
rachael: Quick A/B after ~45m:
- baseline (v3-fp16): avg_latency=160ms p99=210ms concordance_long=0.00%
- canary (v3-int4): avg_latency=150ms p99=235ms concordance_long=-1.2%
long-doc p99 moved up, concordance slightly negative.
sam: long-doc sample=320 (below 500). Hold before automatic rollback. Also KV cache hit-rate lower for int4 on long-docs -> may need warmup.
tian: Agreed. Actions: 1) Hold auto-rollback until sample>=500 OR concordance<=-1.5% sustained 2 windows. 2) Enable soft-fallback for seqlen>2048 now. 3) Run KV warmup on canary nodes and re-measure.
rachael: Logged snapshot + thresholds in BenchDB: https://benchdb/entry/1704509876-spotcheck. Added monitoring alert canary_concordance_alert for delta <= -1.0% over 2 windows.
mike: Running warmup: `./scripts/warm_kv.sh --nodes canary-2024-04-09-01`.
deploy-bot: KV warmup job queued: warmup-9876 for canary-2024-04-09-01.
sam: Post-warmup (10m) rebench: long-doc concordance now -0.8% p99=225ms sample=510. With sample>=500 and concordance between -1.0% and -1.5%, per rules we do NOT auto-rollback but escalate to manual review.
tian: Manual review fine. Opening SR to pause promotion and tag Product for fidelity decision. If concordance hits <= -1.5% in next 30m -> auto-rollback.
rachael: SR filed SR-4521 (pause promo). Exported diffs to /reports/canary-1704509876-diff.json and left notes in the dashboard.
mike: Warmup reduced cold starts; recommend adding optional KV warmup step to canary pipeline for long-doc heavy experiments.
tian: I'll draft a PR to add optional kv-warmup when seqlen-weight > 0.4 in the canary config.
rachael: Current status: HOLD (manual review). long-doc concordance -0.9% sample=530. Dashboard will alert if concordance crosses -1.5% or p99>300ms.
sam: I'll keep collecting 15m sliding-window stats and tag results here. :mag_right:
tian: Thanks all. If Product asks rollback we'll execute hard rollback path; otherwise we'll wait remaining ~75m and decide promote/rollback based on the agreed thresholds and manual review.
